I will do this barley plot the way I can manage with my own money and hands. This plot is very small, so I will not buy a full bag just for it; I will put manure from home and keep the cash for the bigger fields and the house. I will plant the seed I know, and I will depend on the rain because that is what we do here. I will work it with family labor and not bring hired people for such a small piece.
